title: Humility + Opalescence Layer 4/6/7b and Timestamp Order

cited_rules.summary: Layer 4 applies type-changing effects (Opalescence makes each other non-Aura enchantment a creature).
Layer 6 applies ability-removing effects (Humility removes all abilities from all creatures, including Opalescence and itself once Humility is a creature).
Layer 7 applies power- and toughness-changing effects; sublayer 7b applies P/T-setting effects in timestamp order.
Within a layer or sublayer without dependency, continuous effects are applied in timestamp order so the later timestamp wins.

provenance.source_summary: Classic MTG continuous-effect layer and timestamp stress benchmark verifying Layer 4 animation, Layer 6 ability removal, and Layer 7b timestamp precedence.
provenance.scope_notes: Preemptive benchmark authored before full Layer 4/6/7b continuous-effect engine integration; execution_status remains pending-engine until executed against spellwake-engine.

humility.name: Humility
humility.oracle_text: All creatures lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 1/1.

opalescence.name: Opalescence
opalescence.oracle_text: Each other non-Aura enchantment is a creature in addition to its other types and has base power and base toughness each equal to its mana value.

cases.name: Opalescence enters first, then Humility enters second
cases.summary: In Layer 4 Opalescence animates Humility; in Layer 6 Humility removes all creature abilities (including its own, though its continuous effect already began applying); in Layer 7b Humility has the later timestamp so Humility becomes 1/1.

action.description: P1 casts Humility while Opalescence is already on the battlefield.
Humility resolves and enters with a later timestamp than Opalescence.

invariants.description: Opalescence animates each other non-Aura enchantment, so a single Opalescence does not animate itself.
With Opalescence entering before Humility, Humility's Layer 7b 1/1 effect applies after Opalescence's mana-value P/T effect.

cases.name: Humility enters first, then Opalescence enters second
cases.summary: In Layer 4 Opalescence animates Humility; in Layer 6 Humility removes abilities from creatures; in Layer 7b Opalescence has the later timestamp so Humility becomes a 4/4 creature with no abilities.

action.description: P1 casts Opalescence while Humility is already on the battlefield.
Opalescence resolves with a later timestamp than Humility.

invariants.description: Even though Humility loses its own ability in Layer 6, both Humility and Opalescence continue applying in Layer 7b.
Because Opalescence has the later timestamp, Humility's base P/T is set to its mana value (4/4) instead of 1/1.
